invariants.rationale: partitionSmallFilesMap is always initialized and never set to null before return.
If partitionPaths is not null or empty, result will map each path to its small files.
result is empty only if partitionPaths is null/empty or ParquetSmallFileLimit is not positive.
result is always a Map instance as returned by the method.
If partitionPaths is non-null, all its elements are reflected as keys in the result.
